claim_boundary: This contract, adapter specification and synthetic carrier fixtures are not BACH runtime equivalence, BACH-IN, migration, rollback, bundle, installer, or foreign-system evidence.

hold.rule: Do not modify, push, or boot BACH during the active judging hold. Source inspection is static only.

bach.inspection: AST plus SHA-256; the opt-in behavior fixture imports only snapshot.py against an anonymized temporary SQLite database, never the BACH CLI or a live database.

fixtures.privacy: Synthetic node ids, session ids, timestamps, values, tasks, notes, and placeholder secret rows; no BACH database, paths, logs, tokens, or personal records.
fixtures.snapshot_behavior_mode: requires exact BACH_SNAPSHOT_ROOT and an anonymized temporary SQLite database; no BACH CLI, runtime boot or live database

classification.carrier-direct: The neutral carrier exposes the generic mechanism, but BACH output and integration parity are not yet accepted.
classification.adapter-required: The carrier supplies related mechanics; BACH-specific policy, state, output, or lifecycle behavior remains in a future thin adapter.
classification.source-defect-blocked: The current BACH behavior is known to use the wrong source and cannot be made a golden target without resolving that defect.
classification.wrong-carrier-gap: The operation belongs to another semantic domain and must not be forced into sqlite-transit-sync.

dbsync.semantic_domain: verified SQLite snapshot transit and row merge
dbsync.source_dry_run: The current handler receives dry_run but does not honor it for any dbsync operation; the external TransitSync seam is selected lazily and falls back to legacy ProSync on import or contract errors.

operations.name: backup
operations.source_effect: Create a consistent, redacted .bachdb file and update heartbeat.
operations.remaining_difference: Filename, tuple message, and BACH-specific secrets-table policy need adapter translation.

operations.name: cleanup
operations.input: no arguments; source defaults keep_days=7 and keep_per_host=10
operations.source_effect: Delete old transit backups across hosts.
operations.remaining_difference: Carrier verifies pairs, defaults to dry-run and local-node scope; a BACH adapter must explicitly grant apply/all-node authority and translate per-host policy.

operations.name: disable
operations.remaining_difference: Startup/exit activation is host integration state, not neutral database-transit state.

operations.name: enable
operations.remaining_difference: Startup/exit activation is host integration state, not neutral database-transit state.

operations.name: init
operations.source_effect: If no local database exists, copy system/data/bach.db into the local BACH directory.
operations.carrier_surface: CLI init writes configuration only; pull requires an application-created schema
operations.remaining_difference: BACH source documents that its first-copy source is stale and tracks replacement as task 1168; carrier ADR-002 intentionally refuses schema guessing or foreign first-copy.

operations.name: pull
operations.source_effect: When the lazy external TransitSync seam is active, pull through it and update the heartbeat; otherwise merge the newest eligible foreign backup, defer known transient failures, advance per-host state and update heartbeat.
operations.remaining_difference: Carrier now exposes verified pull_selected; BACH newest-only selection, transient cooldown, heartbeat, and first-copy behavior remain adapter concerns.

operations.name: push
operations.source_effect: When the lazy external TransitSync seam is active, publish through it; otherwise create at most one legacy backup per local day and run retention cleanup.
operations.remaining_difference: Daily guard and retention trigger belong in the BACH lifecycle adapter; carrier push always publishes when called.

operations.name: status
operations.source_effect: Report the active external TransitSync seam and pending snapshots when available; otherwise report legacy ProSync state, local path, backup list and heartbeat activity.
operations.remaining_difference: Carrier returns structured JSON state and has no BACH heartbeat display.

operations.name: sync
operations.source_effect: When the lazy external TransitSync seam is active, delegate sync to it; otherwise check active-host heartbeat conflicts, merge newest foreign backup, then create a local backup.
operations.remaining_difference: Heartbeat confirmation, newest-only policy, tuple text, and BACH state translation remain in the adapter.

snapshot.semantic_domain: BACH session checkpoint stored as JSON rows inside the application database
snapshot.boundary_finding: The BACH handler captures current_session, pending tasks, recent working memory, active files and token usage as a JSON checkpoint. The selected session-checkpoint carrier stores only that application-provided object in module-owned local state; sqlite-transit-sync remains the wrong carrier. No Ocean restore adapter or BACH collector is implemented.

operations.name: create
operations.source_effect: Insert six-field JSON session context (session_id, open_tasks, recent_memory, active_files, token_usage, created_at) into session_snapshots; dry-run supported.
operations.remaining_difference: BACH collection, schema-column writes, dry-run and tuple output remain in the future adapter.

operations.name: delete
operations.source_effect: Delete one session_snapshots row; dry-run supported.
operations.remaining_difference: Namespace-scoped id mapping, dry-run and tuple output remain in the future adapter.

operations.name: list
operations.source_effect: List the newest twenty session checkpoint rows.
operations.remaining_difference: The adapter must request namespace bach, limit 20 and format legacy text.

operations.name: load
operations.input: optional snapshot row id; otherwise latest; optional display mode
operations.source_effect: Default load restores missing active working-memory entries and reactivates or creates pending tasks. Display mode is read-only. Neither mode overwrites current_session or restores a database file.
operations.remaining_difference: A future adapter must select latest, preserve display-only behavior and explicitly implement the documented task/memory restore policy while preserving current_session; no restore adapter exists in Ocean.

next_gates: Keep tools/check_k9_data_contract.py as a required regression gate and stop on source or carrier pin drift.
Keep the thin dbsync adapter specification pinned while implementing lifecycle state, daily push guard, heartbeat, cooldown, output translation, and explicit cleanup authority after the hold.
Keep the session-checkpoint capability and anonymized carrier fixture pinned; do not move collection or restoration into the carrier or claim an Ocean restore adapter.
After the BACH hold, run old and new implementations against the same anonymized fixture and compare allowed state changes.
Only then implement BACH-IN adapters and rollback guards.
